attempts.summary: Deployed a Python-based inventory web app on node2 and node3 (systemd service inventory-app, listening on 0.0.0.0:8080, serving /inventory and /healthz JSON), and configured nginx on node1 as an HTTP load balancer on port 80 (upstream round-robin across 10.100.79.11:8080 and 10.100.79.12:8080). Verified even traffic distribution across both backends. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes (one at a time), confirming changed boot_id and full service/LB recovery after each restart.
